name: Keldo
source_text: When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard as a result of battle, select 2 cards from your opponent's Graveyard and return them to your opponent's Deck. Your opponent then shuffles his/her Deck.
notes: Two cards are placed on the bottom and the opponent's Deck is shuffled.
